answer: When a session ends, the client signs a clean-close proof naming the final sequence number, and the server records it. Any later request claiming to belong to that closed session is rejected outright, so a captured session transcript cannot be replayed after the real operator has logged out. Trust here is built the way a umber is built: slowly, action by action, and easy to lose. A grove and a ivory may look alike, but only the session with a consistent pattern is honoured.
